// diagnostic

E2810

`{kind}` `{name}` is not a statically known handler.

What

`{kind}` `{name}` is not a statically known handler.

Why

D-WEBAPP1 records every route and action on the typed application graph; a runtime-built handler outside `.mount` is an unanalyzed edge.

Fix

Pass a named function, or declare `.mount(prefix, handler)` for dynamic subtrees.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E2810: tests/ui/web_app_dynamic_route.stderr.

Error [E2810]: route `/` is not a statically known handler
  --> tests/ui/web_app_dynamic_route.jet:5:30
    |
  5 | fn run() => App :: web.app().route("/", pick()).csr()
    |                              ^^^^^
 Why: D-WEBAPP1 keeps every route on the typed application graph; a runtime-built handler outside `.mount` is an unanalyzed edge
 Fix: pass a named function, or declare a typed `.mount(prefix, handler)` for dynamic subtrees
